graph.llmRoleHelpBody: The default LLM role for the whole graph; agent phases inherit it unless they set their own. Manage roles in Settings › LLM Roles.

renamePhase.dialogDescription: This changes the phase id in GRAPH.md and renames the matching folder under phases.
renamePhase.helperText: Use letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens. The first character must be a letter or underscore.

actions.helpBody: The deterministic functions this logic node runs, in order. Each action is one def <name>(inputs) in actions/<name>.py; the frontmatter list and body <action> tags are kept in sync for you.
actions.empty: No actions yet — add one to scaffold its file.
actions.ioHint: Output fields an action writes are bounded by io.outputs - edit those field boundaries in the I/O panel (toolbar tab 3).

deleteDialog.title: Delete action {{name}}?
deleteDialog.description: Removes {{name}} from this phase and deletes actions/{{name}}.py. This cannot be undone.

addDialog.title: Add action
addDialog.description: Creates actions/<name>.py with a stub and registers it on this phase.
addDialog.invalidName: Use letters, digits, underscore; not starting with a digit.

allowOverwrite.helpBody: Output fields this phase writes that an upstream phase already wrote to the blackboard. Allow the ones you mean to overwrite; any collision left un-allowed is flagged by the engine as an illegal overwrite.
allowOverwrite.empty: No upstream phase output collides with this phase's output fields.

validator.helpBody: When on, the engine runs this node's sibling validator.py after the node finishes to check its output (return None to pass). Create the file to enable it.

subagents.helpBody: Sub-agents this agent can delegate to at runtime. name is referenced in the body with @subagent:<name>; target_skill points at the agent skill being delegated to.

llmRole.helpBody: The configured LLM role this agent runs as. Turn “Use graph default” on to run with the graph’s llm_role (the node’s own pick is kept, just inactive). Manage roles in Settings › LLM Roles; test the graph default in the graph properties.

roleTest.warningDetail: One or more provider routes need attention; rerun the test for provider diagnostics.
roleTest.blockedDetail: The selected role has no currently usable provider route.

nodeParams.helpBody: Opt-in per-node overrides of this node's LLM generation params. When off, the node inherits the role defaults; when on, blank fields still inherit field-by-field.
nodeParams.enableAriaLabel: Use custom model params for this node
nodeParams.thinkingHelpBody: Whether this node asks the model to use reasoning/thinking. Best-effort: only applies when the node's model supports it.
nodeParams.maxOutputHelpBody: Cap on this node's output tokens. Empty inherits the role default (the placeholder shows that inferred max); a value over the route's max is clamped down to it.

subgraphPath.helpBody: Select the child graph folder that contains GRAPH.md. Studio saves a relative path when it can.
subgraphPath.notFound: Path does not resolve to GRAPH.md.

iterate.helpBody: Make this phase run once per item of an array on the blackboard, instead of just once. Leave mode off for a normal single run. I/O fields are edited in the I/O panel.
iterate.modeHelpBody:
off — run once.
batch — map over the array concurrently, each item independent.
loop — iterate serially and accumulate results across rounds.
iterate.overHelpBody: Path to the array field on the blackboard to iterate, e.g. data.inputs.items. The engine runs this node once per element.
iterate.itemVarHelpBody: Name under which the current element is injected onto the blackboard each round, so the node can read “this item”.
iterate.rangeHelpBody: Optional inclusive slice [start, end] (1-based) to iterate only that segment of the array. Leave both empty to run the whole array.
iterate.concurrencyHelpBody: Batch mode only. Max number of items processed at the same time (integer ≥ 1).
iterate.accumulateHelpBody: Loop mode only. Declares how each round's output is gathered into a running value that the next round can read.
iterate.accumulateVarHelpBody: Name of the running accumulator. Each round it is injected onto the blackboard holding everything gathered so far, so the next round can build on it.
iterate.accumulateFromHelpBody: Which field of this round's output to take as the increment that gets merged into the accumulator.
iterate.accumulateInitHelpBody: Initial value of the accumulator as JSON, e.g. [] or {}, before the first round runs.
iterate.accumulateMergeHelpBody:
How each increment joins the accumulator:
append — add the increment as one item.
extend — concatenate a list of items.
merge — merge objects key by key.
replace — overwrite with the latest value.

compare.runAriaLabel: Run model compare for this node

addDialog.title: Add compare LLM
addDialog.description: Choose a model candidate for this node. Saved with the node in the workspace, not SKILL.md.

editDialog.title: Edit compare LLM
editDialog.description: Update this node's model candidate. Saved with the node in the workspace, not SKILL.md.

tools.helpBody: Tools this agent may call at runtime, referenced in the body with @tool:<name>. Each must be declared here first.
tools.empty: No tools yet — add one this agent can call.
tools.builtinHint: Built-in tools (finish_task, read_reference, read_example, log_ambiguity) are always available — don’t list them here.

addDialog.description: Declares a tool this agent may call, referenced in the body with @tool:<name>.

maxIterations.helpBody: The most internal reasoning rounds this agent may take before it must call finish_task. Integer 1–50; defaults to 10 when left empty.

subgraphRefs.helpBody: Child graphs this agent can invoke, referenced in the body with @subgraph:<name>. Each binds a name to a child graph folder (absolute path). This is a runtime resource, distinct from a SUBGRAPH phase node.

resourceRef.fileMissing: File not found in this skill yet.

references.helpBody: Reference documents this agent can consult, cited in the body with @reference:<id>. Each binds an id (e.g. R1) to a file path with a short summary.

examples.helpBody: Example documents this agent can consult, cited in the body with @example:<id>. Each binds an id (e.g. E1) to a file path with a short summary. Distinct from inline <example> tags in the body.

example.noExample: No {{title}} example can be generated from this md file.

blackboardContext.empty: No blackboard fields — import a file below to add input fields.
